hints: Evaluate the range of $f(x) = \frac{48}{x - 1}$ for $3 \le x \le 7$: $[8, 24]$.
Ensure Range($f$) $\subseteq [a, b]$, giving greatest $a = 8$ and least $b = 24$.
walkthrough:
Determine the range of $f(x) = \frac{48}{x - 1}$ on the domain $[3, 7]$:
$$f(7) = \frac{48}{7 - 1} = \frac{48}{6} = 8$$
$$f(3) = \frac{48}{3 - 1} = \frac{48}{2} = 24$$
$$\text{Range of } f: \quad [8, 24]$$

For the composite function $gf$ to exist, the range of $f$ must be a subset of the domain of $g$, $[a, b]$:
$$[8, 24] \subseteq [a, b] \implies a \le 8 \quad \text{and} \quad b \ge 24$$
$$\text{Greatest value of } a = 8, \quad \text{Least value of } b = 24$$

Set $y = \frac{96}{x - 1} - 4$ and solve for $x$:
$$y + 4 = \frac{96}{x - 1} \implies x - 1 = \frac{96}{y + 4} \implies x = 1 + \frac{96}{y + 4}$$

Write the inverse function in terms of $x$:
$$(gf)^{-1}(x) = 1 + \frac{96}{x + 4} \quad \left(\text{or } \frac{x + 100}{x + 4}\right)$$
